# Eidos Developer Documentation

> Canonical developer documentation for the file-based Eidos platform.

Eidos is a local-first personal data environment. A Space is a normal directory
containing files, Bases, versioned data, and optionally extension source.

## Start here

- [Platform introduction](https://docs.eidos.space/getting-started/)
- [Core concepts](https://docs.eidos.space/concepts/)
- [Extension overview](https://docs.eidos.space/extensions/)
- [Markdown Task Board quickstart](https://docs.eidos.space/extensions/quickstart/)
- [Automation and APIs](https://docs.eidos.space/automation/)
- [Reference](https://docs.eidos.space/reference/)

## Extension development

- [Package anatomy](https://docs.eidos.space/extensions/anatomy/)
- [Manifest](https://docs.eidos.space/extensions/manifest/)
- [Lifecycle and activation](https://docs.eidos.space/extensions/lifecycle/)
- [Permissions and trust](https://docs.eidos.space/extensions/security/)
- [GitHub distribution](https://docs.eidos.space/extensions/distribution/)
- [Manifest JSON Schema](https://docs.eidos.space/schemas/extension-manifest.schema.json)
- [Compact extension contract](https://docs.eidos.space/llms-full.txt)

## Status

The current Desktop development tree provides an experimental runtime for
trusted command and text file-editor extensions. Treat the API as unstable
until a stable developer preview is released.

## Legacy

Database-backed APIs and extensions are archived at
https://legacy.docs.eidos.space.
